data.notes: Confirmed dated June music listings are currently concentrated in the official 65th Hvar Summer Festival programme.

events.title: 65th Hvar Summer Festival
events.summary: The 65th Hvar Summer Festival runs from June 21 to September 11, 2026, with programme listings across Hvar’s main square, theatre, Veneranda Summer Stage and other historic venues. The June programme includes the opening ceremony and a traditional klapa a cappella performance.

events.title: Carpe Diem Beach: Terranza After Beach Program
events.summary: Official open-air sunset/after-beach program at Carpe Diem Beach, running daily from 4pm to midnight with free entrance; this is the confirmed June beach-club music program after the venue notes uncertainty around its full late-night program.

events.title: Klapa Bodulke & Klapa Galešnik
events.venueName: Piazzetta in front of the Church of the Holy Spirit
events.summary: Klapa Bodulke and Klapa Galešnik perform as traditional a cappella ensembles at 21:30 as part of the 65th Hvar Summer Festival. The concert is listed for the piazzetta in front of the Church of the Holy Spirit in Hvar.
